annotations.title: Send feedback to the TrackerHacker team

description: Sends a report to the TrackerHacker team: a bug (a tool that fails or does something wrong when it shouldn't), a hack to make, an idea (something TrackerHacker would need to support what the person wants, such as a missing tool or source), praise (what the person likes about it) or a complaint (what annoys or doesn't work for them, though nothing is broken). Before sending, show the person what you'll send and ask, in the same message you offer it, so one yes sends it. Describe the problem in general terms: what you called, what you expected and what happened, and the kind of use case. Never include their emails, sheet values, names, amounts, card, account or phone numbers. If an example helps, use zeros for every number ($0.00, card 0000); a report with other amounts or long numbers is refused. Up to 5 reports a day. The team can reply only if the person gives a replyTo address.

details.description: What happened or what's needed, and why. Under 4000 characters, nothing of the person's.

replyTo.description: An address the team may reply to, only if the person gave it to you for this.

tool.description: For a bug: the tool that went wrong. For praise or a complaint: what it's about, a tool or a part of TrackerHacker (notifications, glance, hacks, inbox, setup).
